incidents.name: Spectra Router arbitrary call
incidents.notes: The Router's command executor did not validate the target/parameters of the commands it dispatched, so the attacker crafted a transferFrom-style call and pulled 188,013 asdCRV out of wallets that had approved the router.

sources.ref: onchain review: router proxy 0x3d20601a... created by 0x020d5ca8bd6451d4c44f784e594f02f352903e61 on 2024-06-28 with a single Upgraded event to impl 0x51bdbfcd7656e2c25ad1bc8037f70572b7142ecc in the creation block; loss is the 188,013 asdCRV (~$73,325) figure from Verichains, not the larger at-risk approval total
